title: PAM detail | regional attention and projection

evidence.statement: Demo explicitly selects CDFA, mynet3 and PAM.

evidence.locator: Prepare Datasets, cut bitemporal image pairs
evidence.statement: A 256 x 256 RGB input is an illustrative size, not a fixed architecture requirement.
evidence.reason: README describes the 256 x 256 non-overlapping patches used in the paper; RGB input follows CDFA netF in_c=3.

evidence.statement: Feature width defaults to 64 and attention downsampling ds defaults to 1.
The same netF instance processes A and B, followed by netA; Euclidean feature distance precedes bilinear distance-map resizing, then threshold dist > 1.
Four ResNet stage outputs are projected to 96 channels, aligned at quarter resolution, concatenated to 384 channels, followed by 3 x 3 to 256 and 1 x 1 to 64.
Official mynet3 instantiation uses a ResNet-18 based backbone with output_stride=32.
Stem Conv7/2 and MaxPool3/2 precede stage outputs 64,128,256,512 at strides 4,8,16,32. This implementation uses 2,2,2,3 BasicBlocks; the last stage uses dilation multipliers 1,2,4.
PAM uses scales [1,2,4,8]. Feature maps are concatenated along width, then split back into dates after attention.

Each s x s spatial grid region includes both dates; keys and queries have C/8 channels and values C. Scaled QK similarity is softmax-normalized and used for weighted value aggregation, then region outputs are reassembled.
Four context tensors are concatenated on the channel dimension and projected with Conv1x1 from 4C to C. This implementation returns the projected output directly, without an input residual addition.
The paper uses a ResNet-18 based multi-scale feature extractor with 96-channel projections and final 256/64-channel convolutions.
The paper defines four scales {1,2,4,8}, per-region attention, channel concatenation and a final 1x1 convolution followed by residual addition to X.
The paper resizes the two feature maps before Euclidean distance, then thresholds distance at 1. This differs from the code order.
For the illustrative 256 x 256 input, the inferred quarter-resolution feature tensor is 64 x 64 x 64.
evidence.reason: Apply the explicit stride-2 stem, maxpool, stage strides and decoder interpolation to 256 x 256; batch axis is omitted.

uncertainties: Scope: fixed official commit 6152d72f55df00a43d341580970be7a58c6b0cd5; CDFA / mynet3 / PAM / f_c=64 / ds=1. This is a sourced redraw, not an official author figure.
All displayed shapes use one illustrative RGB 256 x 256 input, omit the batch axis, and are inferred from the code. Geometry is compressed and non-proportional.

The main diagram abstracts the shared feature extractor and PAM. Companion diagrams expand their topology; BN, ReLU, training dropout, individual residual internals, parameter learning, and BCL supervision are omitted.

Paper/code differences are intentional: paper PAM adds X residually, code PAM2 does not; paper resizes features before distance, code computes distance then resizes it. These alternatives are not combined.
